home.welcome: Welcome. Meetings, transcripts and minutes will live here.

account.title: Account
account.everywhereHint: Signs out every computer and phone signed in to your account, this one included.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.readReceiptsHint: Others see when you've read their messages in one-to-one chats and small groups, and you see theirs. Turn off to stop both.

tiles.headline: Meetings that remember what was said.
tiles.description: Calls with up to 100 people, live captions with names, and minutes in your inbox when the meeting ends.

signIn.title: Sign in to MeetApp
signIn.subtitle: Use your email to sign in.
signIn.legal: By continuing you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy. Meetings with AI notes show a notice to everyone.
signIn.subtitleProviders: Use your work account, or your email.
signIn.noAccountMeeting: Got a meeting link or ID?

password.title: Enter your password
password.subtitle: Or get a one-time code by email instead.
password.label: Password

create.title: Create your account
create.subtitle: Free for individuals and teams.
create.name: Your name
create.nameHint: Shown to people in your meetings.
create.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.
create.terms: I agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy, and I am 16 or older.

steps.confirmHint: Type the 6-digit code we email you.
steps.doneHint: Your personal workspace is ready. Create or join a company workspace any time.
steps.footer: Joining a team? Use the email address your invitation was sent to.

code.sentAfter: Type it here to confirm it's you.
code.label: Code
code.hint: Paste works too. Code expires in {{time}}.
code.expired: This code has expired. Send a new code.
code.resent: We sent a new code. The old one no longer works.
code.asideRule: Works for 15 minutes, once. If you didn't ask for it, ignore the email.
code.asideNote: The same code screen confirms a new email, signs you in without a password, and lets you reset a forgotten one.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.hint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.
newPassword.note: You'll stay signed in here. Other devices will need the new password.

steps.footer: For your safety, every other computer and phone signed in to your account is signed out after the change.

terms.title: Before you start
terms.body: Accept the Terms and the Privacy Policy to use MeetApp.
terms.agree: I agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy, and I am 16 or older.

validation.email: Enter a full email address, like aisha@aria.com.
validation.name: Enter your name (at most 60 characters).

errors.network: Can't reach MeetApp. Check your connection.
errors.wrongPassword: Email or password is wrong. Check both, or use a code instead.
errors.codeInvalid: That code isn't right. Check the email, or send a new code.
errors.codeTooManyTries: Too many wrong tries for this code. Send a new code.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new code.
errors.passwordCommon: This password is too common. Choose another one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts, try again in {{minutes}} minute(s).
errors.unverified: Your Google/Microsoft email isn't verified; create an account with your email instead.
errors.workspaceLimit: You can own at most 20 workspaces.
errors.forbidden: Only the owner or an admin can do that.
errors.ownerMustTransfer: Hand the workspace over to someone else before you leave.
errors.invitationGone: This invitation is no longer valid; ask for a new one.
errors.pendingRequest: You've already asked to join. The owner or an admin will decide.
errors.requestExpired: This request is older than 14 days and has expired.
errors.personalWorkspace: Your personal workspace is only for you.
errors.notFound: That is no longer here. The list has been updated.
errors.passwordWrong: That isn't your current password. Try again, or use a code instead.

browser.title: Finish signing in in your browser
browser.body: Your browser opened {{provider}}. Sign in there, then check that the page shows this code:
browser.help: Closed the browser tab? Press Cancel and try again.

switcher.heading: Your workspaces
switcher.join: Join with a link or code

create.title: Create a company workspace
create.description: A shared place for your team's meetings, minutes and AI answers. You'll be its owner.
create.name: Workspace name
create.hint: Usually your company or team name. 2 to 60 characters.
create.nextInvite: Invite teammates by email. Anyone in the workspace can invite others.
create.nextJoin: Or turn on a join link and code. You approve each request to join.
create.nextPersonal: Your personal workspace stays private to you.

notices.removed: You are no longer a member of {{name}}.

people.title: People in {{name}}
people.summary_one: {{count}} person · anyone here can invite others as members.
people.summary_other: {{count}} people · anyone here can invite others as members.

invite.title: Invite by email
invite.hint: They join as soon as they accept. Invitations last 7 days.
invite.empty: Type at least one email address.
invite.tooMany: Send at most {{max}} invitations at a time.
invite.limit: Invite limit reached, try again tomorrow.

link.title: Join link and code
link.description: Anyone signed in who has them can ask to join. You or an admin approves each request.
link.off: The join link is off. The owner or an admin can turn it on.
link.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

confirm.removeText: {{name}} loses access to {{workspace}} at once. What they created stays in the workspace.
confirm.transferText: {{name}} becomes the owner. You become an admin. Only the new owner can undo this.
confirm.leaveText: You lose access at once. What you created stays in the workspace.

requests.title: Requests and invitations
requests.description: People asking to join with the link or code, and invitations waiting for an answer.
requests.noRequests: Nobody is asking to join right now.
requests.footnote: Requests expire after 14 days. Approved people join as members.
requests.noInvitations: No invitations are waiting for an answer.
requests.resent: A new invitation was sent to {{email}}.

join.title: Join a workspace
join.description: Accept an invitation, or use a join link or code from a colleague.
join.noInvitations: No invitations for this email right now.
join.codeTitle: Join with a link or code
join.codeHint: The owner or an admin approves each request.
join.notFound: No workspace found. Check the link or code, or ask for a new one.
join.empty: Paste a join link or type a code.
join.people_one: {{count}} person · you'll join as a member
join.people_other: {{count}} people · you'll join as a member
join.sentText: We'll tell you when the owner or an admin of {{name}} approves it. Requests expire after 14 days.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.subtitle: Settings for {{name}}. Only its owner and admins can change them.
settings.name: Workspace name
settings.saved: Name saved. Everyone in the workspace sees it within a minute.
settings.allowGuestsHint: People without an account can join this workspace's meetings by link, after the lobby. When off, they are told "This meeting doesn't allow guests"; guests already in a meeting stay.
settings.allowGifsHint: People can search and send GIFs in this workspace's meeting chat. Their search words go to our GIF service (KLIPY); names and meetings never do.
settings.allowOutsideChat: Chat with people outside the workspace
settings.allowOutsideChatHint: Members can start chats with anyone on MeetApp by email, and people outside can send them chat requests. When off, existing outside chats become read-only.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Seen by people who share a workspace with you.

photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Location details are removed.
photo.rule: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB.

account.title: Account and sign-in
account.passwordHint: Changing it signs out your other devices.
account.noPassword: No password yet. You can set one with a code sent to your email.
account.methodsLinked: {{list}} linked. A code by email always works.
account.methodsNone: A code by email always works.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Your other devices will be signed out. This one stays signed in.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.description: Lost a laptop or used a shared computer? Sign out everywhere ends every session, including this one.

data.title: Your data
data.text: To get a copy of your data or delete your account, email {{email}}. We reply within 30 days.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Start a meeting now, make a link for later, or join one. Meetings you make belong to {{workspace}}.

start.label: Start a meeting
start.meetNowText: Start a meeting right away. Share its link from inside.
start.getLinkText: Make a link to share for later. Nobody joins until it's used.

join.title: Join a meeting
join.guestNote: No account? Guests can join from the sign-in screen with the link, or the ID and passcode.

guest.title: Join a meeting
guest.subtitle: Use the link, or the meeting ID and passcode, that the organizer sent you.

ready.title: Your meeting link is ready
ready.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
ready.note: People in {{workspace}} join directly. Others wait in the lobby until someone lets them in. The link stops working 60 days after it was last used or changed.

options.title: Meeting options
options.lobbyHint: Guests always wait until someone with an account is in the meeting.
options.presentHint: Presenters can share their screen, let people in, mute and remove others.
options.coHint: Only you, the organizer, can change this. Up to 10 people from this workspace.
options.coHintOthers: Only the organizer can change this.
options.addCo: Add a person from this workspace
options.allowMicHint: When off, attendees stay muted until you turn it back on or make them presenters.
options.allowCameraHint: When off, attendees can't turn their camera on.
options.guestsNote: Whether guests can join is set for the whole workspace by its owner and admins.
options.lockHint: Nobody new can join. People who leave can't come back, except you and co-organizers.
options.chatHint: "In-meeting only": after the meeting, only organizers can read the chat.

preJoin.straightIn: You're in this workspace, so you'll go straight in.
preJoin.lobby: You'll wait in the lobby until someone in the meeting lets you in.
preJoin.nameRule: Type a name of 1 to 60 characters.
preJoin.terms: By joining, you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy.

errors.notFound: We couldn't find that meeting. Check the link, or the ID and passcode.
errors.expired: This meeting has expired. Ask the organizer for a new one.
errors.locked: This meeting is locked. Ask the organizer to unlock it.
errors.full: This meeting is full (100 people). Try again when someone leaves.
errors.noGuests: This meeting doesn't allow guests. Sign in with an account to join, or ask the organizer.

devices.label: Your camera and sound
devices.remembered: These choices are remembered on this computer.

camera.missing: No camera found. Plug one in, or join without video.
camera.busy: Your camera is in use by another app. Close that app, or join without video.
camera.denied: MeetApp isn't allowed to use the camera: open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera and turn on MeetApp.

microphone.missing: No microphone found. Plug one in, or join without sound.
microphone.busy: Your microphone is in use by another app. Close that app, or join muted.
microphone.denied: MeetApp isn't allowed to use the microphone: open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and turn on MeetApp.

lobby.waiting: Someone in the meeting will let you in soon.

call.speaker: Speaker
call.mutedYouBody: You can unmute yourself when you want to talk.
call.endingSoonBody: Meetings last at most 30 hours. Start a new one to keep talking.
call.shareEndedBody: Someone else started sharing, so your share stopped.
call.failedBody: The person may have left, or your role changed. Try again.
call.waitingBar: {{count}} people are waiting in the lobby:
call.connectingBody: Joining the call. This takes a moment.
call.reconnectingBody: Your connection dropped. MeetApp is trying to bring you back.
call.weakBody: Others may see you in lower quality.
call.noiseSuppressionHint: Cuts background noise like typing and fans.
call.unreachable: Can't reach MeetApp. Check your connection.

denied.title: You've been denied entry
denied.body: Someone in the meeting didn't let you in.

timedOut.title: Nobody let you in
timedOut.body: You waited 15 minutes in the lobby. You can try again.

removed.title: You were removed from the meeting
removed.body: {{name}} removed you. If you join again, you'll wait in the lobby.

ended.title: The meeting has ended
ended.body: The meeting was ended for everyone.

locked.title: This meeting is locked
locked.body: Nobody new can join right now. Ask the organizer to unlock it.

noGuests.title: This meeting doesn't allow guests
noGuests.body: Sign in with an account to join, or ask the organizer.

left.title: You left the meeting
left.body: You can join again with the link, or the ID and passcode.

lost.title: You've lost connection
lost.body: We couldn't reconnect in 30 seconds. Check your network, then rejoin.

share.title: Choose what to share
share.note: Everyone in the meeting will see it. If someone else is sharing, your share replaces theirs. Sound from your computer isn't shared.
share.blockedBody: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording, turn on MeetApp, then restart it.

end.title: End the meeting for everyone?
end.body: Everyone, including people in the lobby, will leave at once.

chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyHint: Messages here are seen by everyone in the meeting.
chat.tooFast: You're sending messages too fast. Try again in a few seconds.
chat.deleteBody: Everyone will see "This message was deleted". Its text and any file are removed for good.

newPoll.title: Create a poll
newPoll.description: Everyone in the meeting can vote.
newPoll.question: Question
newPoll.anonymousHint: Nobody, not even you, will see who voted for what.

chat.off: Chat is turned off for this meeting.

files.tooBig: Files can be up to 25 MB. "{{name}}" is too big.
files.wrongKind: This kind of file can't be sent: "{{name}}".
files.tooMany: You can send up to 10 files a minute.
files.meetingFull: This meeting has reached its file limit.
files.dropTitle: Drop files to share in chat
files.dropHint: Pictures, PDF, text, CSV, Word, Excel, PowerPoint · up to 25 MB each

gifs.unavailable: GIFs aren't available right now. Try again later.
gifs.notice: What you type here is sent to our GIF service to find GIFs. Your name and the meeting are not.

recent.title: Recent meetings
recent.empty: Meetings you take part in show here, so you can read their chat afterwards.
recent.failed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.

readOnly.blocked: You can't send messages in this chat.
readOnly.outside_off: Chat with people outside the workspace is turned off.
readOnly.left_workspace: This person is no longer in the workspace.
readOnly.left: You're no longer in this chat.

new.title: New chat
new.hint: Type a name, or anyone's email. One person opens a one-to-one chat; two or more start a group.
new.externalDetail: Not in this workspace · they'll get a chat request first
new.noAccount: No one with this email uses MeetApp yet. Invite them by email; you can chat once they join.
new.inviteFailed: Couldn't send the invitation to {{email}}. Try again.

requestsPane.title: Chat requests
requestsPane.hint: People outside your workspaces. They can't see your status until you accept.
requestsPane.explanation: Accept to chat and share your status. Delete removes the request; {{name}} isn't told and can't ask again for 30 days.
requestsPane.alsoBlock: Also block {{name}} (they can't message you or see your status)

group.name: Group name

history.days: History from the last few days

group.leaveHint: You'll keep what you've seen, but won't get new messages.
group.addHint: Colleagues join at once; people from outside get a chat request first.

load.failed: Couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.

readOnly.blocked: You can't call in this chat.
readOnly.outside_off: Calls with people outside the workspace are turned off.
readOnly.left_workspace: This person is no longer in the workspace.
readOnly.left: You're no longer in this chat.
readOnly.pending: You can call once they accept your chat request.

failed.rate: You're calling too often. Try again in a minute.

calling.title: Calling {{name}}…
calling.line: Ringing. They can accept with video or audio.
calling.declinedLine: They can call you back from the chat.
calling.noAnswerLine: {{name}} didn't answer. They'll see a missed call in the chat.
calling.preview: Your camera is on. Others see you once they accept.

incoming.label: Incoming call
incoming.leave_acceptVideo: Leave current call and accept with video
incoming.leave_acceptAudio: Leave current call and accept with audio

add.title: Add people
add.intro: People in this chat who aren't in the call. Their app rings when you add them.
add.everyone: Everyone in this chat is in the call.
add.note: To call someone who isn't in this chat, add them to the group first. A call holds up to 20 people.
add.full: This call has 20 people, the most it can hold.

otherDevice.label: Call on another device
otherDevice.title: You're in a call on another device
